shots.action: Close on a young gunner curled inside the steel ball of a bomber's belly turret, seen through its round front window: a flak burst flashes orange outside, the window cracks across in a star, he flinches and his eyes go wide
shots.camera: Close, outside the window, easing in

shots.action: Inside the fuselage: his chest parachute pack hanging on its hook, torn open; white silk spills out of it in rags and shreds, daylight coming through holes in the skin behind it
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter, pushing in

shots.action: Daylight, high above cloud: a four-engined bomber rolls over and goes down trailing black smoke, one engine on fire; a tiny dark figure tumbles away under its belly
shots.camera: Below and beside, tilting with the roll

shots.action: Straight down: a long arched railway-station roof of glass and iron among the roofs of a town, rushing up at the lens
shots.camera: Top down, falling

shots.action: A crow in a long coat and hat stands on the iron ridge of the station roof, glass panes sloping away either side of his boots. He looks up at a tiny figure falling out of the sky above him, then at us, brim low, and speaks
shots.camera: Low on the roof, looking up past him

shots.action: Daylight over the sea coast: a formation of four-engined bombers in a staggered line, black flak bursts blooming all round them, each with an orange flash at the heart
shots.camera: Wide, alongside the formation, tracking

shots.action: Under the bomber's belly: a flak burst goes off right beside the ball turret; the ball jolts, fragments fly, and its guns sag and stop turning
shots.camera: Close below the belly, looking up, shaking

shots.action: Inside the fuselage: the hatch of the turret in the floor. The gunner hauls himself up out of it on both arms into the waist of the plane, smoke drifting past, light through flak holes
shots.camera: Low, beside the hatch, rising with him

shots.action: He pulls his parachute pack off its hook: it falls open in his hands and the silk drops out in rags. His face falls. Behind him the crow flinches, hat hopping
shots.camera: Medium close, front three-quarter

shots.action: The crow holds a strip of the torn silk up to a shaft of daylight from a flak hole, pokes a wingtip through one of the holes in it, then taps his beak
shots.camera: Close, side light, easing in

shots.action: The gunner sways in the fuselage, mask hanging loose, fumbling for something to hold; his eyes drift shut and he slumps against the ribs
shots.camera: Close, tilting slowly with him

shots.action: Outside: the bomber's broken waist, a ragged hole in its side; a limp figure is flung out among scraps of metal as the plane rolls away above him
shots.camera: Beside the fuselage, holding as the plane pulls away

shots.action: From above: one small limp figure turning slowly in the open sky, a white cloud layer far below him and a coastline beyond
shots.camera: High above him, looking down, rolling

shots.action: The crow dives beside him, wings tucked, one wingtip clamping his hat on his head, eyes wide, looking across at the falling man and then down
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter, falling with him

shots.action: Straight down past the man's boots: the town, the harbour, and the long glass roof of the station growing in the middle of the picture
shots.camera: Over his shoulder, looking straight down, sinking

shots.action: On the station roof: the crow looks up, his hat jumps off his head, and he backs off down the glass with his wings up, eyes on the sky
shots.camera: Low, across the ridge

shots.action: Inside the station, looking up at the arched glass roof: a section bursts inward as he comes through, a fan of glass and splinters of light
shots.camera: From the platform, looking straight up

shots.action: Glass pours down through sunbeams onto the platform; the crow at the edge of the platform has both wings over his head, peeking out between them
shots.camera: Low on the platform, wide

shots.action: Stillness: looking straight up at the ragged hole in the glass roof, the iron ribs around it, daylight pouring through, a few last glints falling and dust turning
shots.camera: Flat on the platform, looking straight up, slowly rotating

shots.action: Men in plain grey greatcoats and caps run in and kneel beside the gunner lying on the platform among the glass; he moves one hand. The crow stands back with his hat held to his chest
shots.camera: Low, along the platform, pushing in

shots.action: The crow picks a shard of glass up off the platform, turns it in the light, looks up from it to the hole in the roof, then holds his wings apart to measure the hole
shots.camera: Close, low, tilting up with his look

shots.action: Two of the men carry him on a stretcher along the platform past the locomotive, the dust still in the light
shots.camera: Side on, tracking with them

shots.action: A plain hospital room: the gunner in bed with his arm in a white cast; a doctor in a white coat bends over him, listening, then straightens up and nods
shots.camera: Medium, from the foot of the bed, easing in

shots.action: The crow at the foot of the bed lifts his hat brim, looks at the man, and gives one slow nod
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter

shots.action: Snow, a wire fence, a wooden hut: the gunner stands at the wire with his arm in a sling, looking out; the crow is perched on a fence post beside him, coat collar up
shots.camera: Medium wide, tracking slowly along the fence

shots.action: A quiet town square in soft morning light: a plain stone memorial on a plinth, a wreath at its foot. The crow stands beside it with his hat off, held at his side, and lowers his head
shots.camera: Tracking slowly in towards the stone, sinking

shots.action: Close on the wreath at the foot of the stone, a few petals moving in the wind; a black-feathered hand lays one more flower on it
shots.camera: Close, low, easing in

shots.action: Back in the station under the hole in the roof: the crow puts his hat back on, tugs the brim, holds up the shard of glass so it glints, and pockets it
shots.camera: Low, pushing in

shots.action: Rook's case board, iron and glass: a photograph of the hole in the station roof, 22,000 FEET, NO PARACHUTE, GLASS ROOF
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: Back to the first picture: the gunner in the ball turret behind its round window, played back to its first frame
shots.camera: The opening framing
